title: Vegetables at the Market | Fun Kids Song & Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - English
description:
Join the kids on a colorful trip to the market with Papa, where they pick red tomatoes and orange carrots!
A cheeky goat learns that sharing (and old cabbage leaves) makes everyone happy.
Eating your veggies helps you grow up strong and bright!

Vegetables, veggies, fresh and bright, red and green and orange too! Off we go to the market, Papa? With a cloth bag, swing, swing, swing! Red, red, red, red tomatoes, Orange carrots, crunch, crunch! Veggies, veggies, fresh and bright, Red and green and orange too! Crunch, crunch, crunch, crunch, Rainbow colors, hooray, hooray! Shh, shh, a goat comes sneaking, "Hey goat!" we shout, "hey, hey!" Munch, munch, munch, munch, Spinach peeking from the bag! Veggies, veggies, fresh and bright, Red and green and orange too! Crunch, crunch, crunch, crunch, Rainbow colors, hooray, hooray! The seller laughs, "Oh, what a goat!" Gives him old cabbage leaves, Chomp, chomp, chomp, chomp, goat is eating "Meh-eh, thank you!" says the goat. Veggies, veggies, fresh and bright, Red and green and orange too! Crunch, crunch, crunch, crunch, Rainbow colors, hooray, hooray! Home we go with a full bag, Amma cooks, "come, come, eat!" Veggies, veggies, veggies, veggies, Eat your veggies, grow up strong!
